category_title: High-intelligence elementary student with inattentive ADHD and executive functioning deficits
scenario_title: One-on-one desk organization and homework management
minimal_context: Gail and the school psychologist are working one-on-one during lunch recess to organize her desk and review her homework assignments.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Since we are here during lunch recess, let's pull everything out to organize your desk and check your missing homework assignments.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I'm glad you came to help me with this project. There are a lot of loose papers in here.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's look at these missing assignments. What is happening with your studying?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don’t get good grades because I don’t study outside class.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to complete these assignments and turn them in on time.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I have too many things to do after school so I don’t always get my homework done. I just tell my mom, 'Later, mom, later. I’ll do it later.'
